Our bank

A trusted national bank.

National Banking Corporation Limited is a fully licensed commercial bank, owned and led by Papua New Guineans and backed by local ownership and government investment. We serve individuals, families, communities, SMEs and corporate clients nationwide.

NBCL began in 2013 as a micro-finance institution, formerly People's Micro Bank, and is now a full-service commercial bank with services in 11 centres and digital channels including online and mobile banking.

Our vision is to be a trusted, PNG-owned bank that expands access to fair, modern banking across the country, supporting inclusive growth in urban and rural communities. Next, we're strengthening our core capabilities, improving digital access, expanding merchant services and deepening our support for local businesses.

Our mission

Making modern banking accessible to all Papua New Guineans.

Banking the underserved

Reaching unbanked and underserved people by combining branches with digital channels.

Driving financial inclusion

Lowering barriers with simple, transparent and affordable products.

Empowering local enterprise

Helping SMEs and micro-enterprises move into the formal banking system.

Our values

What we stand for.

Simpler, fairer, accessible

Straightforward products with clear terms and low barriers to entry.

Community trust & inclusion

Fair treatment, inclusion and national reach over short-term gain.

Integrity & compliance

High regulatory standards, transparency and customer protection.

Practical innovation

Resilient systems and digital tools suited to everyday life in PNG.

Leadership

Board of Directors

Darrell Seeto

Chairman

Chair of the Transformation Committee

Read bio+

Darrell has about 30 years' experience in retail and commercial banking, corporate finance, and debt and equity capital markets, including equity and FX derivatives across international markets.

He has worked at leading financial institutions including NAB, Ord Minnett Securities, JP Morgan, Salomon Smith Barney (the investment banking arm of Citigroup) and Macquarie Bank in Australia, holding roles as Vice President in JP Morgan's Wealth Management Division, Senior Vice President at Citigroup and Division Director at Macquarie Bank. He is currently a Senior Adviser at the Australian firm Shaw and Partners.

Darrell holds a Bachelor of Commerce (Accounting) from the University of New South Wales and a Graduate Diploma in Applied Finance from the Securities Institute of Australia. He is a certified accountant, a senior associate of the Australian Institute of Bankers, a master practitioner member of the Stockbrokers and Financial Advisers Association of Australia, and a member of the PNG Institute of Directors.

Nehemaiah Naris

Non-Executive Director

Chair of the Remuneration and Nominations Committee · Member of the Transformation Committee

Read bio+

Nehemaiah is a commercial professional with more than 17 years' experience across oil and gas, power, telecommunications, banking and finance, and agribusiness. Most recently he was Deputy Chief Executive Officer and then Acting Chief Executive Officer of PNG Power Limited, overseeing the nation's primary electricity provider from February 2023 to October 2024.

He previously held senior roles at Kumul Consolidated Holdings, including Chief Investment Officer, and was Commercial Lawyer at the National Petroleum Company of PNG (now Kumul Petroleum Holdings).

Nehemaiah holds a Bachelor of Laws from the University of Papua New Guinea, a Master of Laws in Corporate and Commercial Law from the University of Auckland, and an MBA from the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign. He is a graduate member of the Australian Institute of Company Directors and a member of the PNG Law Society. He joined the Board in July 2022.

Une O'Ome

Non-Executive Director

Chair of the Audit and Risk Committee · Member of the Remuneration and Nominations Committee

Read bio+

Une was appointed to the Board in July 2022 as an independent director and brings more than 24 years of experience in technology and digital.

He holds a Master's degree in Communications (Telecommunications) Management from the University of Strathclyde, United Kingdom, and an Engineering degree from the PNG University of Technology, Lae. Une previously worked with the National ICT Authority and has headed the Commercial Division at PNG DataCo since 2014.

Une is a fellow of the Institution of Engineers PNG, a member of the PNG Institute of Directors and the Australian Institute of Company Directors, and a Council member of the University of Western Pacific. He is passionate about using technology to improve business processes and systems.

Gabriel Pepson

Non-Executive Director

Member of the Audit and Risk Committee

Read bio+

A former Ambassador to the European Union, Gabriel has represented Papua New Guinea in trade and investment on the international stage. He served as Secretary for the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade, responsible for all international matters including trade and investment, geopolitics, and international and domestic border security, and as Ambassador to the World Trade Organization in Geneva.

Gabriel was Chief Advisor to the government on foreign policy and has served on many boards and committees. He is currently a board member of Kumul Consolidated Holdings, providing oversight of KCH and, by extension, all state-owned enterprises, and is Chancellor of IBS University.

Gabriel was appointed to the Board in June 2022.

Executive Leadership Team

Adam Downie

Acting Chief Executive Officer

Appointed June 2023

adownie@nbcpng.com.pg[Phone]
Read bio+

Adam is a dynamic and versatile leader with a proven track record of achievement in retail and business banking, innovation, digital financial services, lending, and marketing. With over fifteen years of senior leadership experience, Adam has consistently demonstrated his ability to lead large teams, drive profitable growth, and manage P&L responsibilities.

Adam’s career highlights include leading the successful acquisition of ANZ PNG by Kina Securities Limited, where he played a pivotal role as a member of the Joint Implementation Committee. He provided strategic direction and governance, contributing to the seamless integration of ANZ’s retail, SME, and commercial businesses into Kina Bank, resulting in Kina Bank becoming PNG’s second-largest bank with 100% customer retention.

As the Executive General Manager at Kina Bank, Adam was responsible for delivering exceptional customer experiences and driving retail and business banking streams. His strategic thinking, attention to detail, and leadership of large, cross-functional teams were instrumental in achieving on-time and on-budget integration.

At Westpac Pacific, Adam developed and implemented a transformational strategy that significantly grew the customer base and introduced innovative digital financial products. His leadership in establishing a financial inclusion innovation hub earned the program the prestigious Reuben James Summerlin Innovation Award and recognition in a TED video.

Adam’s leadership at Westpac PNG saw the bank’s retail segment grow from third to second largest in the country, achieving top customer satisfaction rankings and substantial increases in profitability. His initiatives in digital transformation and community engagement, including through the Westpac Outstanding Women awards, have left a lasting impact. He holds a Bachelor of Business Information Systems from the University of South Australia.

Adam was appointed to NBCL in June 2023, where he continues to bring his energetic and passionate approach to people, customers, staff and stakeholders, driving transformation and growth.

Vicky Vene

Chief Financial Officer

vvene@nbcpng.com.pg+675 301 5418
Read bio+

Vicky is a distinguished figure in Papua New Guinea’s accounting and finance sector with over 15 years’ expertise. Holding a Master’s Degree in Professional Accounting and CPA PNG accreditation, she excels in financial management and strategic leadership.

Prior to joining NBCL, Vicky served as Acting Chief Executive Officer for National Development Bank where she delivered high quality business strategies, oversaw all operations and business activities, and made high-quality investment decisions. Her leadership was instrumental in navigating the bank through significant strategic change.

Before her role as Acting CEO, Vicky was the Group Chief Financial Officer where she played a pivotal role in enhancing corporate governance and led key initiatives such as budget preparation and strategic planning. Her commitment to excellence and proactive approach have earned her recognition as a trusted leader and key influencer in the financial services industry.

Kerry Walsh

Head of Treasury

kwalsh@nbcpng.com.pg[Phone]
Read bio+

Kerry brings an exceptional wealth of experience and expertise to NBCL, leveraging over a decade of leadership in Westpac PNG’s financial markets. As the former Head of Financial Markets, Kerry achieved a significant increase in market share by fifteen percent over two years. He consistently exceeded income targets, contributing annually to a ten percent growth in foreign exchange income under his strategic guidance.

His tenure at Westpac encompassed pivotal roles in operational risk and compliance, where he fostered robust risk management frameworks and enhanced operational efficiencies across the bank.

Kerry’s career highlights include overseeing the development and implementation of financial strategies, managing market risks and ensuring stringent compliance with regulatory standards. He holds a Diploma in Business Studies from the Canberra Institute of Technology and Accreditation in Financial Markets from the Australian Financial Markets Association. His leadership has been instrumental in expanding market share and achieving income targets while his collaborative approach has cemented strong client relationships and empowered teams to deliver exceptional financial services.

Gorethy is a marketing and communication specialist with over 20 years of experience in the banking and Fast-Moving-Consumer-Goods (Food and Beverage) industries. She holds a Masters in Business Administration and Bachelors Degree in Journalism at the University of Papua New Guinea.

She brings a wealth of experience and expertise to NBCL, from her past leadership roles in reputable organisations such as BSP Financial Group Limited (BSP), Nestle PNG, SP Brewery, Kina Securities (pre Bank) and PNG Olympic Committee.

Katie Fan

Head of IO Private Banking

[Email][Phone]
Read bio+

Katie Fan is an accomplished banking executive with more than 23 years of experience launching and scaling high-value banking services across Australia and international markets. She has held senior leadership roles at ANZ, National Australia Bank, Westpac and Kina Bank, where she led Corporate Banking & Advisory, and has built a strong reputation for driving commercial growth, operational transformation and customer-centric innovation.

Katie's technical expertise spans quantitative modelling, data automation, project finance, bank, sovereign and country risk management, alongside a deep background in relationship lending. Katie brings a customer-first mindset to every solution, ensuring strategic decisions remain grounded in real client needs and measurable outcomes.

Having lived in Papua New Guinea for over seven years, Katie has a genuine appreciation for the country's rich resources and rich cultural diversity. At NBCL, she is focused on driving sustainable financing solutions and strategic differentiation that support NBCL’s long-term vision and growth.

Katie holds a Doctorate (Ph.D.) from Swinburne University of Technology, Australia, and an Executive MBA from the University of Hertfordshire, United Kingdom. She is also a published author.

Sumeet Kumar

Chief Information Officer

skumar@nbcpng.com.pg+675 301 5480
Read bio+

Sumeet Kumar is an accomplished banking technology executive with more than 21 years of experience in financial services technology across the Pacific region. He joined National Banking Corporation Limited (NBCL) as Chief Information Officer in September 2026.

Sumeet began his banking technology career with Westpac Pacific in Fiji and has spent the past 15 years in Papua New Guinea, holding senior technology leadership roles with BSP, Kina Bank, and CreditBank PNG. Most recently, he served as Chief Technology Officer at CreditBank PNG, where he played a key role in establishing the bank’s technology foundation and digital capabilities.

As Chief Information Officer at NBCL, Sumeet leads the Bank’s Technology Division and oversees technology strategy, digital transformation, IT operations, cybersecurity, technology governance, and innovation. He focuses on strengthening the Bank’s technology resilience, operational excellence, information security, and digital capabilities to deliver secure, reliable, customer-centric banking services.

Throughout his career, Sumeet has successfully led major technology transformation initiatives, including core banking implementations, digital banking modernisation programs, payment system integrations, infrastructure and cloud transformation projects, and cybersecurity enhancements. He is passionate about using technology to drive business growth, improve operational efficiency, and enhance the customer experience.

Sumeet holds a Bachelor of Science in Computing Science and Information Systems from the University of the South Pacific, Fiji.
